title: Flat K-flat module resolutions from the source library
statement: For a commutative ring A and every unbounded cochain complex M of A-modules, there exist a cochain complex P and a quasi-isomorphism s:P to M, with every term P^n categorically flat and P categorically K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Categorical flatness agrees with module flatness. No boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 15.60.10; the generic construction is already proved in the source FlatModel module.

proof.text: Use the functorial flat resolution of ModuleCat A, regarded as a left resolution by flat objects, and reduce it. Apply its unbounded resolution functor to M. Its resolution natural transformation supplies the map s and is a quasi-isomorphism. The construction is the filtered colimit of compatible bounded-above total flat resolutions. Each bounded-above flat complex is K-flat; exact filtered colimits and tensor preservation of those colimits imply K-flatness of the unbounded resolution. Evaluation preserves colimits, and flat objects are closed under these filtered colimits, so every term is flat. This is exactly the proved source theorem exists_quasiIso_flat_kFlat, specialized to ModuleCat A.
